_comment: Claude Sonnet 4.6 (claude_sonnet_client.py) is the extraction engine; deterministic pdfplumber (with OCR for scanned pages) is the non-AI last resort. "claude" (claude_client.py) is not in the chain: it is the exception-explanation model (src/ai/explanation_service.py). The Gemini, Mistral, Azure OpenAI and Document Intelligence providers were removed 2026-10-30.
